attchmntText: GSP Crop Science Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: GSP Crop Science Limited submitted an investor presentation regarding its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The filing was made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The presentation is available on the company website at www.gspcrop.in. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, income from operations was 9,444 million rupees, up from 8,443 million rupees in the prior period. Profit after tax stood at 710 million rupees compared to 811 million rupees previously. EBITDA margin was 12.3 percent. The company reported a 20 percent increase in international business revenue.

attchmntText: GSP Crop Science Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Q2 & H1 FY27 Results ".
voiceSummary: GSP Crop Science Limited filed a press release regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Revenue from operations increased by 19.5 percent year-on-year to Rs. 5,584 million in Q2FY27. Gross profit rose by 2.6 percent to Rs. 1,932 million. EBITDA decreased by 21.0 percent to Rs. 736 million, with an EBITDA margin of 13.2 percent. Profit after tax fell by 23.7 percent to Rs. 446 million. The company cited improved realizations as the primary driver for revenue growth. Margins faced pressure due to raw material costs and supply challenges. Cost optimization strategies helped improve sequential EBITDA margins. The outlook depends on weather conditions and El Niño impacts on agricultural demand.

attchmntText: Submission of Monitoring Agency Report issued by Crisil Ratings Limited for the utilization of Proceeds raised through issuance of Equity Shares by way of the Initial Public Offer (IPO) of the GSP Crop Science Limited ( the Company ) for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: GSP Crop Science Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, issued by Crisil Ratings Limited regarding the utilization of proceeds from its Initial Public Offer. The report was noted by the Audit Committee and Board of Directors on November 13, 2026. The IPO size was Rs 4,000.00 million, with net proceeds of Rs 2,203.17 million. The company utilized Rs 1,700.00 million for repayment of borrowings and Rs 503.17 million for general corporate purposes. Issue expenses of Rs 179.02 million were incurred, leaving an unutilized balance of Rs 17.81 million in the public issue account. No deviations from the objects of the issue were reported.

attchmntText: GSP Crop Science Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: GSP Crop Science Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a net profit of 442.28 million rupees for the quarter and 707.97 million rupees for the half year. Earnings per share stood at 9.51 rupees for the quarter and 18.14 rupees for the half year. The Board appointed Mr. Shail Jayesh Shah as Chief Financial Officer effective November 13, 2026. Mr. Rajesh Valiya Naduvath retired from the company on the same date. The Board approved shifting the corporate office to Ahmedabad effective December 3, 2026. The company confirmed no deviation in the utilization of IPO proceeds.
